text: Sorry, I really hope this isn't wasting anyone's time. I'm a childminder and I've got a little boy staying over tonight, he's 5, his mum's working a night shift and I can't get hold of her at the moment. It's probably nothing but I've just realised I don't think he's been for a wee since about lunchtime, and it's gone 1am now. I've been going back over the day in my head and I honestly can't remember him going once, so I think it's been at least 12 hours, maybe more. I did ask him when I put him to bed and he said he didn't need to. He's also got one eye that's gone a bit pink and sticky, gunky in the corner, I wiped it with cooled boiled water. His colour looks normal to me, skin and lips just how they always are, nothing pale or odd there. I just don't know if the wee thing is something to worry about or if I'm overthinking it because he's not mine. Sorry again, I'd rather ask than not.
